name: description-list
title: DescriptionList
description: Term/value pairs in a <dl>: the term beside its value or above it, optionally divided by rules; long values wrap.

manifest.name: description-list
manifest.title: DescriptionList
manifest.description: Term/value pairs in a <dl>: the term beside its value or above it, optionally divided by rules; long values wrap.
manifest.usage: Use DescriptionList for the facts of one thing: the grant summary in the approval dialog, a connection's details, About and diagnostics. Compose DescriptionList > DescriptionListItem > DescriptionListTerm + DescriptionListDetails (one or more). layout="stacked" in narrow panels; divided adds rules between items. For many records with the same fields use Table; for a single number use Stat.

props.name: layout
props.description: inline: the term (a third of the width) beside its value; stacked: above it.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: item
slots.description: One term and its values; data-slot="description-list-item".

parts.name: DescriptionListItem
parts.description: Groups one term with its values.

accessibility: A real <dl> with <dt> and <dd> (each pair in a <div>, which HTML allows), so screen readers announce the list and pair terms with values.
Terms are color.fg.muted and values color.fg.default, both contrast-checked as text.
Long values (digests, paths) wrap instead of overflowing; not focusable.
